REPLICATION.summary: Returns the replication state of a standby member for a volume.

reply_schema.description: The replication state of the standby.

stage.description: SEGMENT_REPLICATION or CHANGE_DATA_CAPTURE. Empty string if replication has not started.

cursor.description: Segment and byte offset the standby is replicating.

status.description: WAITING, RUNNING, DONE, STOPPED or FAILED. Empty string if replication has not started.

error_message.description: Last error message, or an empty string if none.

cdc_stage.description: Progress of the change data capture stage.

position.description: Byte offset in the current change data capture segment.

segment_replication_stage.description: Progress of the segment replication stage.

tail_sequence_number.description: Sequence number of the segment tail.

tail_next_position.description: Next byte offset after the segment tail.

arguments.name: volume-name
arguments.summary: The name of the volume, in the format <kind>-shard-<id>.

arguments.name: standby-id
arguments.summary: Full 40-character hex member id or a 4-character prefix of the standby.
